'''Natural''' was a shop that was located on the outskirts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gadrin]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. It operated during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
The shop was established and run by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] couple [[Selima DeWitt]] and [[Percival Vale]]; and the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Higgie Sethven]]. It sold native crafts, local fruits and [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]] about the Cularin fauna and flora. When Sethven discovered a drug that could be made from the [[star-mist]] plant, he contacted the company [[Genasys]] and they sent a security team to the shop, to meet with him. However, [[Culpharm]], a rival company of Genasys, were tipped off about the deal and they sent a security team of their own, to prevent the meeting from happening. The Culpharm team attacked the Genasys one, resulting in a firefight in and around the shop. DeWitt, Vale and Sethven remained inside the building and were eventually rescued by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
